archetype: 5 - Jewel & Luxury combined with 4 - Swiss & High-Contrast for productivity clarity
mood: distraction-free, clean, premium, editorial, private executive workspace

rules.headings: Tight tracking (tracking-tight), never purely centered unless explicit structural need. No bold by default—use font-light or font-medium for elegance.
rules.labels: Uppercase, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]), tiny text for overlines and tags.
rules.hierarchy: Use fluid scaling. H1 max text-5xl. Use sharp scale drops between H1 and body.

layout.container: Max width 1440px, generous padding (p-8 to p-12).
layout.sidebar: Fixed width 280px, border-r border-white/5, very subtle. Optical alignment for icons.
layout.cards: Cardless or flat solid with 1px border-white/5. No soft drop shadows. Hover states: -translate-y-1, border-white/10.
layout.spacing: Use 2x normal spacing (e.g., gap-8 instead of gap-4) to create a luxurious, uncrowded feel.
layout.dashboard_grid: Control Room Grid: strict hierarchy, dense data but breathable inside cards. Use bento-style spans.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-md). Primary uses the gold accent, but sparsely. Default to ghost or outline buttons with subtle gold hover.
components.dialogs: Backdrop blur, pure black overlay (bg-black/80), sharp modal box with 1px border.
components.pills_tags: Small, uppercase, strict sans. border border-white/10 text-xs text-text_secondary. Gold accent border for active/selected state.

motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade and slight upward drift on load.

auth_background.description: Black background with abstract gold swirls, used for the sign in/sign up page.

empty_state_vault.description: Abstract gold and black circle texture, used for empty states in the content vault.

empty_state_action.description: Intricate golden wave patterns creating a luxurious abstract art piece, used for empty action loops.

icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (light or regular weight). They provide the premium, fine-line look suitable for this luxury aesthetic.

testing.rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='move-to-action-btn', data-testid='sidebar-nav-vault', data-testid='create-note-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Cabinet Grotesk via Fontshare CDN: <link href="https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@800,500,700,400,300&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"> in index.html.
Install Google Font: Manrope for body text.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts to ensure precision; use Shadcn for complex forms/dialogs but strip Vercel-look borders and shadows.
Force dark mode via <html class='dark'> or standard Tailwind strategy, as light mode is completely discarded for this project.
In the Action Loop, avoid highly saturated colorful status chips. Use monochrome chips with subtle text colors and a thin gold border for 'In Progress'.
In the Gold Sources Directory, use Phosphor's brand icons (XLogo, YoutubeLogo, LinkedinLogo).
The Dashboard Accountability Score should be MASSIVE text (text-6xl or text-8xl) in Cabinet Grotesk, centered, purely typographical with no circular progress or decorative charts—just the number.
Never use pure black background for cards or pure #000000; stick to the defined palette of #0A0A0A (Base) and #121212 (Surface).
Use sonner for toasts, but override styles to be dark background (#1A1A1A) with a thin border-white/5.
Start every section with an empty state layout utilizing the provided images in a subtle, desaturated manner (opacity-50 or mix-blend-screen).
